Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a short-term contractor for the Artist & Label Partnerships team in Vietnam. 
The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Focusing on the Vietnamese music landscape, this role will serve as the point of contact for record labels, distributors and artists, ensuring that artists & their teams are familiar with Spotify standard methodologies, resources and tools. The role will closely support the cross-functional teams with on-platform promotion and off-platform artist marketing. 

Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.
description:
Spotify is looking for a short-term contractor for the Artist & Label Partnerships team in Vietnam. 

The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Focusing on the Vietnamese music landscape, this role will serve as the point of contact for record labels, distributors and artists, ensuring that artists & their teams are familiar with Spotify standard methodologies, resources and tools. The role will closely support the cross-functional teams with on-platform promotion and off-platform artist marketing.

Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Maintain positive partnerships across artist and label communities within Vietnam.
  • Support our key partners in Vietnam on Spotify tools, resources and insights.
  • Work closely with our cross functional teams to support artists and labels on priority releases in Vietnam
  • Collaborate with the regional Music team to ensure content strategies are localized and successfully executed.
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Vietnam and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users.

• You have at least 3+ years of working experience in the music/entertainment industry. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage. 
  • Extremely well organized, dedicated with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail.
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Vietnam and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community.
  • You have a strong background in music and technology and a consistent record with operations.
  • You have a strong grasp of content knowledge, music and cultural trends, artists, user engagement and behaviors. 
  • You have excellent stakeholder management skills. 
  • You have experience working within Vietnam and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams.
  • You are very fluent in written and spoken English and Vietnamese.&n

descriptionBody:
Spotify is expanding our Agency development team dedicated to driving new and innovative strategic partnerships with our largest agency partners in France. You will showcase all the technological and data assets available to drive business goals.

The Agency Development Lead will own strategic agency partnerships across the French market. This is not an account management role — you'll architect the agency relationships and commercial frameworks which create opportunities for the FR sales team to activate. You bring deep experience in partnership development and senior agency relationships at the holding company level, with an established track record of building long-term consultative solutions and innovative ways of working with agencies which create value for advertisers.  You have a passion for digital media, music, podcasts and innovation, and you know how to translate that into commercial strategy.
